description: Moves an appointment to a new start time, optionally with another provider who offers the same service. Two steps: call without confirm for a preview, then, after the person agrees, again with confirm: true, the confirmation_token from the preview and an idempotency_key. Easy!Appointments emails the customer about the change.

confirm.description: Leave false (the default) to get a preview without changing anything. Set true only after the person has seen the preview and agreed.

confirmation_token.description: Required when confirm is true: the confirmation_token from the preview of exactly these arguments. It expires after a few minutes; if it has, get a new preview.

idempotency_key.description: Required when confirm is true. Any unique string, for example a UUID. Reusing it with the same arguments returns the first result instead of acting twice.

new_start.description: New start "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" in the time zone of the provider it moves to, from find_open_slots.

provider_id.description: Optional: move to this provider. Defaults to the current one.

name: reschedule_appointment
title: Reschedule an appointment
